side_effects_note: LogPrintf on RigorSupplyDelta coinbase reject is I/O only; not consensus-relevant.
notes: GetResMintReward(0) is the schedule value W(0)=RES_REWARD_GENESIS. Genesis ConnectBlock does not apply that mint as circulating issuance. These are different facts.
RigorSupplyDelta's BlockValidationState argument is a reject-reason sink, not hidden chain state.
LogPrintf in RigorSupplyDelta is I/O and does not change accept/reject or numeric outputs.
ResolveConvergenceDraw lives in convergence_logic.cpp, a mixed TU that also contains window builders. The function body is pure; the TU is not isolated.
ClassifyRigorAsset is a façade over AssetTypeFromScriptPubKey / ClassifyRigorTxout. One matcher.

kernel_functions.name: RigorIssuanceEpoch
kernel_functions.notes: epoch = height/RES_REWARD_EPOCH; height<0 returns 0. Same division as GetResMintReward.

kernel_functions.name: GetBlockSubsidy
kernel_functions.notes: Production ORU schedule. height==0 -> ORU_GENESIS_BLOCK_SUBSIDY (0). Negative height is not a production input; it follows the h>=1 formula (representational risk).

kernel_functions.name: ComputeRigorIssuance
kernel_functions.notes: Wrapper: epoch + GetBlockSubsidy + GetResMintReward. Does not copy a second schedule.

kernel_functions.name: GetResMintReward
kernel_functions.notes: Canonical RES schedule. Not redefined by P047. height 0 = W(0).

kernel_functions.name: RigorSupplyDelta
inputs: BlockValidationState (output reject sink, not a consensus input)
kernel_functions.notes: Does not read chain/UTXO/DB. Does not mutate UTXO.

kernel_functions.name: RigorResCoinbaseExpected
kernel_functions.notes: fees_res + bootstrap + mint. Predicate, not an assembler.

kernel_functions.name: ResolveConvergenceDraw
kernel_functions.notes: F = set.candidates. σ computed from set fields. T is the second argument. Winner is 512-bit argmin with txid tie-break; independent of scan order. GetConvergenceDrawSetForBlock is not this function.

kernel_functions.name: ClassifyRigorAsset
kernel_functions.notes: Façade: returns AssetTypeFromScriptPubKey. Matcher is ClassifyRigorTxout. ClassifyRigorSpendPredicate does not exist.

boundary.mixed_translation_unit: convergence_logic.cpp also contains window builders and includes chain.h/coins.h. Not a Kernel file for the lint.
boundary.classify_header_layering: rigor_classify.cpp includes predicate_verify.h (Transaction Kernel header). Function body does not call sighash/Ed25519.
boundary.coinbase_header_names_builder: rigor_coinbase_layout.h documents BuildCoinbaseCommitmentScriptSig. That function is construction (miner/GBT). Kernel does not call it.
